When updating the firmware of this model for the first time, installing the USB Driver is required before connecting the update device to the computer.
(Installing the driver is not required for the second and subsequent updates)

Would you like to install the USB Driver?

Next, prepare the device you want to update.

1. Switch the device you want to update to "Program writing mode".

2. After switching mode, connect the device to your computer using a USB cable.

3. Press the "Next" button.
When updating the firmware of this model for the first time, press the "USB Driver Install" button, then install the USB Driver.
